name: CircleAvatar
description: A circular widget that typically represents a user profile picture. Can display an image, icon, or text inside a circle.

properties.name: child
properties.description: A widget to display inside the circle, usually Text or Icon.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The background color of the circle.

properties.name: foregroundColor
properties.description: The default color for text and icons within the avatar.

properties.name: radius
properties.description: The radius of the circle. If null, defaults to 20.0

properties.name: minRadius
properties.description: The minimum radius constraint for the circle.

properties.name: maxRadius
properties.description: The maximum radius constraint for the circle.

properties.name: backgroundImage
properties.description: An image to display inside the circle.

properties.name: onBackgroundImageError
properties.description: Callback when the background image fails to load.

properties.name: foregroundImage
properties.description: An image displayed over the background image.

properties.name: onForegroundImageError
properties.description: Callback when the foreground image fails to load.
